title.zh: Strategy Reports $19.53 Billion in Q3 Net Income, Sells $432 Million in Bitcoin
title.en: Strategy Reports $19.53 Billion in Q3 Net Income, Sells $432 Million in Bitcoin

current_state.zh: Strategy posted $19.53B in Q3 2026 net income on $20.91B of digital asset gains, disclosed roughly $431.8M of year-to-date Bitcoin sales to fund preferred dividends and STRC buybacks, and reported holding 848,517 BTC as of October 25, while announcing CFO Andrew Kang's departure.
